title: Ancestor rediscovers the seven lost Spanish gold mines of New Mexico

tellings.quote: goes looking in New Mexico for the uh the seven lost Spanish gold mines of of southern New Mexico and within a year he discovered them and he opened up these 450 year old gold mines

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns tells podcast host Jesse Michels a family story about an ancestor in the early 1900s. He says this relative went searching in southern New Mexico for seven gold mines left by the Spanish centuries earlier and long since lost, and found them within a year. According to Caverns, the ancestor reopened these mines, about 450 years old, which he offers as proof that old legends about hidden places can turn out to be real.
